verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs say users can "manage your local models, prompts, and configurations" (docs-6), and MCP servers can be connected to local models (docs-19). Together these suggest prompt and tool setups could be tailored per task, but nothing describes creating named, reusable custom assistants. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and saving task-specific assistants or presets (system prompt plus parameters plus tools bundled), a way to switch between multiple specialized assistants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
